title: C$^2$-Routing: Complementary Cropping and Compression for Efficient Vision-Language Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.14469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual Question Answering (VQA) imposes substantial computational overhead on vision-language models (VLMs), motivating model-agnostic input reduction methods that can be readily applied across diverse VLMs, including in black-box settings. Simply enforcing a visual-token cap reduces computation, but it can discard information needed to answer the question. A single reduction strategy also struggles to accommodate different scenarios. Our key observation is that cropping and compression are complementary: cropping highlights small targets and local details, whereas whole-image compression better preserves context for large targets or distributed evidence. Based on this observation, we propose C$^2$-Routing, which adaptively selects cropping or compression according to the input image and question. translated_title: C²-Routing：面向高效视觉语言推理的互补裁剪与压缩
translated_abstract: 视觉问答（VQA）给视觉语言模型（VLM）带来了巨大的计算开销，这促使人们研究模型无关的输入缩减方法，这类方法可以方便地应用于各种视觉语言模型，包括黑盒设置。简单地强制设定视觉token数量上限虽然可以减少计算量，但可能会丢弃回答问题所需的信息。单一的缩减策略也难以适应不同的场景。我们的关键观察是：裁剪和压缩是互补的——裁剪能够突出小目标和局部细节，而整图压缩则能更好地保留大目标或分散性证据的上下文。基于这一观察，我们提出C²-Routing，根据输入图像和问题自适应地选择裁剪或压缩策略。由于这两种策略仍可能丢弃关键信息，我们进一步设计了一个安全门机制，利用预测的联合正确性分布来保障回答质量。
tldr: 提出C²-Routing方法，利用裁剪（突出小目标与局部细节）与压缩（保留全局上下文）的互补性，根据图像和问题自适应路由选择缩减策略，并配合安全门机制，在降低视觉语言模型计算开销的同时保留回答问题的关键信息。
en_tdlr: C²-Routing adaptively routes between complementary visual input reduction strategies—cropping for small targets and local details, and compression for global context—augmented with a safety gate, enabling efficient and accurate VQA inference across vision-language models.
